text:
amanda_cs: Customer Pelmor Labs reports their 50-credit trial popped into a shadow workspace after an SSO restore. They have two workspaces: pelmor-prod and pelmor-shadow. Can someone from eng/billing confirm and move credits back? Promo: TRIAL-2026-50. account_id: acct_8421

devon_billing: can you paste the workspace IDs and the promo code id? also send any timestamps if available.

amanda_cs: WS IDs: pelmor-prod -> ws_1111, pelmor-shadow -> ws_9999. Promo code id: promo_TRIAL-2026-50. Customer says admin ran an org restore via Okta this morning at 08:12 UTC.

sam_engineer: do we know if SCIM provisioning created a duplicate org entry? any identical external_id/enterprise_id between the two orgs?

amanda_cs: support got this from the customer: SCIM payload shows the user claim for the restored org uses the same external_id as prod. snippet:
```json
{"id":"ws_9999","external_id":"pelmor-v1","name":"pelmor-shadow","sso":true}
```

olivia_platform: that external_id match is the likely cause — our promo allocation runs off of external_id dedupe in the onboarding flow. I'll run a quick DB check.

repro-bot: Created ticket CS-9876 for escalation: https://redwood.internal/CS-9876

olivia_platform: running query: 
```sql
SELECT credit_id, workspace_id, amount, applied_at FROM credits
WHERE promo_code = 'TRIAL-2026-50'
AND workspace_id IN ('ws_1111','ws_9999');
```
results: credit_id: cred_7701, workspace_id: ws_9999, amount: 50, applied_at: 2026-03-01T08:15:22Z

devon_billing: ok it's confirmed attached to ws_9999. we need an audit log entry before moving. can eng produce a dry-run to show what will change?

sam_engineer: propose transfer flow: 1) verify customer ownership, 2) dry-run transfer that doesn't write, 3) actual transfer, 4) append audit log event and email customer. internal API example (dry run = true):
```http
POST /internal/admin/credit-transfer
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "from_workspace_id": "ws_9999",
  "to_workspace_id": "ws_1111",
  "credit_id": "cred_7701",
  "amount": 50,
  "reason": "SSO restore attached promo to restored tenant",
  "dry_run": true
}
```

amanda_cs: customer confirmed admin performed the restore and can provide Okta logs if needed. happy to get dev to run dry-run.

olivia_platform: I'll run the dry-run now and post output. :thumbsup:

olivia_platform: dry-run output:
```json
{"transfer_id":"tx_dry_5566","status":"ok","from":{"workspace_id":"ws_9999","remaining_credits":0},"to":{"workspace_id":"ws_1111","new_credits":50}}
```

devon_billing: looks good. please proceed with actual transfer and include audit metadata (requester: amanda_cs, ticket: CS-9876).

olivia_platform: executing actual transfer now.

olivia_platform: transfer complete. transfer_id: tx_5566, moved 50 credits from ws_9999 to ws_1111. Audit: {requester: "amanda_cs", ticket: "CS-9876", reason: "SSO restore mis-attach"}.

amanda_cs: forwarded confirmation to customer; they verified their prod workspace shows the 50 credits. Customer asked what caused it and how to avoid in future.

sam_engineer: root cause: SCIM/SAML restore created a second workspace with the same external_id; onboarding promo dedupe looked at external_id during apply and matched the restored workspace. action items: 1) update onboarding to ignore archived/restored workspaces for promo apply, 2) add a console preflight that flags duplicate external_id on restore, 3) docs update for SSO restore runbook.

amanda_cs: I'll log the action items in CS-9876 and follow up with the customer. thanks all. :heart:
